boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented study environments on OU’s Norman campus, spanning quiet reading tables, computer work, individual seating, and collaborative rooms.

cards.entity_name: Peggy V. Helmerich Great Reading Room
cards.title: Peggy V. Helmerich Great Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, Main Floor
cards.notes: Set up at the large study tables for quiet work. Bring a covered drink if needed; food is not permitted in this historic reading room.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, table-based reading room framed by carved bookcases of OU theses and dissertations.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries identifies the Great Reading Room as a quiet study space with large study tables; it permits covered beverages but not food.
cards.source_title: Peggy V. Helmerich Great Reading Room | OU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on Bizzell Memorial Library’s Main Floor; follow current OU Libraries building hours.

cards.title: Helmerich Collaborative Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, Lower Level 1
cards.notes: Use the open collaboration area for project work, then reserve a collaboration room when your group needs its own technology-equipped space.
cards.short_summary: A technology-enabled Lower Level 1 setting for group work, with whiteboards and reservable collaboration rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries describes the Helmerich Collaborative Learning Center as a technology-enabled collaborative space with open study space, whiteboards, and reservable collaboration rooms.
cards.source_title: Helmerich Collaborative Learning Center | OU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Eight study rooms may be reserved online or in person by OU students; check current library hours before visiting.

cards.title: Learning Lab
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, Lower Level 1
cards.notes: Choose an individual or collaborative seat, and pair a work session with Action Tutoring when you want academic support nearby.
cards.short_summary: A Lower Level 1 study area that combines individual and collaborative spaces with tutoring access.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries states that OU students have collaborative and individual study spaces in the Learning Lab, along with Action Tutoring.
cards.access_notes: For OU students; the entrance is slightly elevated, with ramp and elevator routes documented by OU Libraries.

cards.entity_name: Zarrow Family Faculty & Graduate Student Center
cards.title: Zarrow Family Faculty & Graduate Student Center
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, Lower Level 2
cards.notes: Graduate students and faculty can use this center for focused research work or reserve an eligible personal study space and meeting room.
cards.short_summary: A Lower Level 2 research-focused center with individual and collaborative work areas.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries identifies the Zarrow Center as a space supporting OU faculty and graduate students’ research and teaching needs.
cards.access_notes: Reserved for faculty and graduate students; rooms on Lower Level 2 have additional eligibility restrictions.

cards.title: Scholars Lounge
cards.subtitle: Zarrow Center, Bizzell Memorial Library, Lower Level 2
cards.notes: Use the lounge for considerate, quieter work with a view toward the Canyon Garden; confirm your graduate-student or faculty eligibility first.
cards.short_summary: A considerate-study lounge within the Zarrow Center, positioned beside the Canyon Garden.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries lists the Scholars Lounge as a considerate study area in the Zarrow Center and limits it to faculty and graduate students.
cards.source_title: Physical Accessibility & Sensory Guide at Bizzell Memorial Library | OU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available to faculty and graduate students in the Zarrow Family Faculty & Graduate Student Center.

cards.title: Bizzell Study Pods
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, Lower Level 1 east side
cards.notes: Take a pod for a solo work block when you want cushioned seating, a footrest, and a foldable laptop tray rather than a standard desk.
cards.short_summary: Considerate-study pods with recliner-style seating and foldable laptop trays.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries identifies Lower Level 1 east-side study pods as considerate study and documents recliner-style seats with footrests and foldable laptop trays.
cards.source_title: Physical Accessibility & Sensory Guide at Bizzell Memorial Library | OU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on Lower Level 1’s east side; follow current Bizzell Memorial Library access and hours information.

cards.title: Bizzell Individual Cubicles
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, Lower Level 1 east side
cards.notes: Choose an individual cubicle when a dedicated wooden desk and small rolling chair better suit a focused laptop or reading session.
cards.short_summary: A Lower Level 1 individual-work option with desk-based seating.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries documents individual cubicles on Bizzell’s Lower Level 1 east side with wooden desks and small rolling chairs.
cards.source_title: Physical Accessibility & Sensory Guide at Bizzell Memorial Library | OU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on Lower Level 1’s east side; follow current Bizzell Memorial Library access and hours information.

cards.entity_name: Bizzell Third Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Bizzell Third Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, east and northwest sides
cards.notes: Head to the book-stack areas for quiet work, using the long wooden tables or available cushioned and office-style seating as needed.
cards.short_summary: A quiet floor-level study area among the stacks, with mixed seating and table styles.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries designates the east and northwest sides of Bizzell’s third floor as quiet study areas and documents varied seating there.
cards.source_title: Physical Accessibility & Sensory Guide at Bizzell Memorial Library | OU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Cell-phone use is prohibited on Bizzell’s second and third floors; follow current library hours.

cards.entity_name: Bizzell Fourth Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Bizzell Fourth Floor Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: Bizzell Memorial Library, north and southeast sides
cards.notes: Settle into the quiet study areas by the stacks for independent work; ramps provide a continuous route across the floor’s internal transition.
cards.short_summary: A quiet, stack-adjacent fourth-floor environment with mixed cushioned and standard seating.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries identifies quiet study spaces along the north and southeast walls of Bizzell’s fourth floor.
cards.source_title: Bizzell Memorial Library Floor Maps | OU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Fourth-floor ramps are documented on both sides of the internal stair transition; follow current library hours.

cards.title: Grant Fine Arts Library
cards.subtitle: Catlett Music Center, Room 020
cards.notes: Use this lower-level library for a change of setting while working with art, music, theatre, dance, or architecture research materials.
cards.short_summary: A Fine Arts neighborhood library in Catlett Music Center with books, scores, periodicals, and recordings.
cards.evidence_claim: OU Libraries states that the Grant Fine Arts Library is located in Room 020 on the lower level of Catlett Music Center and holds books, scores, periodicals, and recordings.
cards.source_title: History of the Fine Arts Library | OU Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located at the corner of Elm and Boyd streets; consult OU Libraries for current location hours and visitor access.
